title: Subsidiaries
summary: Subsidiaries is part of the Accounting Standards for Private Enterprises (ASPE).
description: This standard is part of the ASPE framework issued by the Canadian Accounting Standards Board. It provides guidance on subsidiaries.

bannerNotice.title: Consolidation Is a Choice, Not a Requirement
bannerNotice.body: ASPE permits a parent to elect consolidation, the cost method, or the equity method for subsidiaries — a fundamental divergence from IFRS 10 and ASBE No. 33, which mandate consolidation.
